A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CUE research and contain 16 readable pages, including Appendices A.1–A.7. Text, equations, figures and tables support a reliable comparison after matching relocated content.

before.justification: v1 reports original CUE experiments on TriviaQA and SciQA, plus ablations, medical-dataset transfer experiments, cross-model evaluations and sensitivity analyses in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the main benchmark comparisons, ablations and appendix generalization and sensitivity analyses.

M1.justification: Sections 4.1–4.3 retain the same labeling procedure, encoder-based classifier, binary cross-entropy objective, score normalization and weighted correction. The corrected summation typesetting does not establish a different training objective or procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate TriviaQA and SciQA and retain the MedMCQA/MedQA transfer experiments in Appendix A.4. Cross-domain and cross-model evaluation coverage is unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the same nine UE baselines. Table 3 retains Wb-S comparisons on PE, LN-PE, SE and the SAR variants, while Table 2 retains GPT-4o scoring. The revised Appendix A.3 heading introduces no comparator.

E3.justification: The target models, AUROC/F1/ECE metrics and evaluation procedures are unchanged. Section 5.1.5 retains 5,000 TriviaQA training samples, the full SciQA training set and the half-test-set division between weight tuning and evaluation; appendix transfer protocols also match.

E4.justification: Both versions retain the score-combination analysis, correction-format and acquisition ablations, base-model comparison, transfer tests, weight sensitivity and pure-Corrector analysis. Moving Figure 7 into Section 5.3 redisplays an existing ablation.

E5.justification: Appendix A.5 retains the same t-tests against SE and the SAR variants and the same p < 0.05 reporting. Although v2 removes Section 5.2's pointer to this appendix, the statistical analysis and uncertainty-reporting practices remain unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–7 and the plotted results are unchanged. For example, both versions report LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct's TriviaQA SE AUROC as 80.92 without correction and 82.12 with correction in Table 1.

T1.justification: Appendix A.2's definitions and derivations are unchanged. Section 4.2 repairs misplaced summation bounds in the already specified binary cross-entropy formula; this is a typesetting correction, with no substantive change to mathematical reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract retains the up-to-60% improvement claim. The introduction and conclusion preserve the same contributions: a lightweight Corrector that integrates with existing methods to improve indication, precision-recall balance and calibration across models and domains.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning complementarity, probabilistic correction and limited transfer across dissimilar models are retained. Both versions acknowledge dependence on labeled data, generalization limitations and the absence of black-box experimental validation.

D1.justification: Repository and model links, labeling instructions, data-splitting information and weight-tuning details are unchanged. The new funding acknowledgement and corresponding-author designation add no implementation or reproducibility details.

R1.justification: The reference lists contain the same works, and Section 2 and Appendix A.1 retain the same research positioning. Rewording the supervised-method comparison does not alter its relationship to prior work.

P1.justification: v2 makes scattered grammar corrections, rephrases the supervised-comparison paragraph and adds 'Other' to the Appendix A.3 heading. It also adds a corresponding-author note and funding acknowledgement and removes the main-text pointer to A.5. The overall narrative structure is retained.

P2.justification: Figure 7 moves from appendix page 15 to Section 5.3 on page 8, with a small caption edit and unchanged graphics. Table 2 and surrounding text reflow, shifting the conclusion to page 9. The loss summation is typeset correctly; table structures and other figure content remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves readability through grammar fixes, correctly displayed loss summation bounds and placement of Figure 7 beside its discussion. Removing the pointer to Appendix A.5 is a small navigation drawback, but the statistical evidence remains available. The gains are presentational; scientific methods, results and limitations are unchanged.
